risk_note: CT-27 (BR-TEXT-28 / 29 / 30; 编排 D10-2361 / D10-2379 / D10-2401 / D10-2410 / D10-2433 / D10-2446 / D10-2457): operation slots batch 1 contract — home-schema adds page_key me / search with admission definitions (home / me / search), section and static item start_at / end_at (+08:00), icon_grid props for me (columns 4, 1–12 items, badge none / dot / text ≤2 with expiry, icon {url, sha256} bound to the shown picture), search_top at most one (banner or product_scroll with more_action in-app only), core entries refused on me / search (home keeps its existing types, D10-2446); openapi adds the admin search settings read and three closed PUTs (hot words, keyword routes, default word; content.page, no step-up, x-signed false); getPage note distinguishes a display-only popup (items: [] at configuration) from a popup whose configured items were all filtered (not sent). The legacy string badge in specs/client/home-sdui-vectors.json became a badge object (D10-2433 ①). Client-side fall-back notes moved to CT-27a (D10-2457).

reviews.note: Codex contract r1 fail 5 S1 + 1 S2 → r2 fail 2 S1 (string badge ruled D10-2433 ①; InviteShare fixed) → r3 fail 1 S1 (home core-entry link, ruled out_of_scope D10-2446) → r4 under approvals 137 fail (popup fall-back, admission_home) → r5 under approvals 139 fail (two S1 in notes added by the sweep) → split D10-2457: notes moved to CT-27a, r6 under approvals 143 pass with no findings (couli-runs/CT-27/review-contract-r6-codex.json).

spec_test_review.note: Rule tests by fresh independent Claude (claude-run.sh, approvals 36), attempts 1–3; Codex spec-test r1 / r2 fail, r3 under approvals 131 fail with no new S1 (6 unclosed) → 编排 D10-2401: the 6 made contract must-haves (each with a contract-level unit test / golden counter-example) and FU-CT-27-SPEC-R3-GAPS follows right after merge. The ledger declares no red_exempt / rows / renames / expected_values, so evidence-check does not require a pass here.

longrun.note: no change under test/properties, packages/money, packages/domain or packages/testing; the required longrun-props check runs on the PR head
